enum entry_kind: payment, refund

table ledger_entries [row level security, forced]
  column id uuid not null default gen_random_uuid()
  column organisation_id uuid not null
  column provider_event_id text not null
  column kind entry_kind not null
  column amount_minor bigint not null
  column currency character(3) not null
  column description text not null default ''::text
  column occurred_at timestamp with time zone not null
  column received_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
  check ledger_entries_amount_positive: CHECK ((amount_minor > 0))
  check ledger_entries_currency_format: CHECK ((currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text))
  foreign key ledger_entries_organisation_id_organisations_id_fk: FOREIGN KEY (organisation_id) REFERENCES organisations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  primary key ledger_entries_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
  unique ledger_entries_provider_event_id_key: UNIQUE (provider_event_id)
  index ledger_entries_organisation_occurred_idx: CREATE INDEX ledger_entries_organisation_occurred_idx ON public.ledger_entries USING btree (organisation_id, occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST)
  index ledger_entries_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_entries_pkey ON public.ledger_entries USING btree (id)
  index ledger_entries_provider_event_id_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_entries_provider_event_id_key ON public.ledger_entries USING btree (provider_event_id)
  policy ledger_entries_tenant_isolation: PERMISSIVE ALL to tenant_ledger_app
    using (organisation_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_organisation_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid)
    with check (organisation_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_organisation_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid)
  grant to tenant_ledger_app: INSERT, SELECT
